name: Munin 2.0 (open 120B Danish/English agentic-coding model)
summary: 120B-parameter (12B active) open-weights model from Danish Foundation Models, post-trained from NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super Base with SFT on LUMI and RL on software-engineering/terminal tasks on Gefion. Model card reports SWE-bench Verified 66.2% (58.1% SFT, 49.3% Nemotron 3 Super in the same harness), 128k context. BF16 weights plus NVFP4 (Blackwell) and SFT checkpoints; served with vLLM (README example uses 8 GPUs).

access.notes: License states works are commercially usable; redistribution must keep notices and include 'Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Nemotron Model License'. Not gated on HF. Card: no dedicated safety training, run agents in sandboxes.

procedure: Open the Hugging Face repo danish-foundation-models/munin-2.0 (no login, not gated)
Download the BF16 safetensors (~247 GB total) with huggingface-cli or git, or use the munin-2.0-nvfp4 repo on Blackwell GPUs
Serve with vLLM 0.28 per the model card (trust-remote-code, qwen3_coder tool parser, nemotron_v3 reasoning parser)
Call it through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint

verdict.why: Verified: HF repo not gated, weights resolve, license read on NVIDIA page (commercially usable). Substantive open release with measured agentic-coding gains, but a general LLM needing a multi-GPU server; outside the creative-asset core (cf. Inkling 2 Mini reject 11-21).
